身体里的微观世界 · 观察与发现: Inside the body · Observe and discover
结构与过程示意 · 颜色和时间经过调整: Structure and process models · Colour and time are adjusted
红细胞和白细胞在做什么？: What do red and white blood cells do?
沿着一小段血管，看红细胞运送氧气、白细胞到达组织，以及血小板帮助封住破口。: Follow a small blood vessel: red cells carry oxygen, a white cell reaches tissue, and platelets help seal a break.
放大看血液中的分工：运氧气、参与防御，以及一起帮助止血。: Explore jobs in blood: carrying oxygen, immune defence and working together to stop bleeding.
图中数量、大小、流速和时间不按真实比例。血管是局部纵切示意；运氧、白细胞迁移、局: Counts, sizes, flow speeds and times are not to scale. The vessel is a local longitudinal section. Oxygen transport, white-cell migration and local hemostasis are separate scenes, not three inevitable stages of one blood sample. Gold markers represent selected oxygen molecules, not visible bubbles. Red and white cells are drawn at similar sizes for tracking; many white cells are larger in reality.
细胞与组织的互动示意图: Interactive illustration of cells and tissues
红细胞为什么中间薄、边缘厚？追踪六个金色氧气标记，看看离开血管的是氧气，还是整个: Why is a red cell thinner in the middle? Follow six gold oxygen markers. Does oxygen leave the vessel, or does the whole cell leave?
红细胞里的血红蛋白能结合氧气。这里从它已经带着氧气的一刻开始。: Hemoglobin inside the red cell can bind oxygen. This scene begins after it has picked up oxygen.
一部分氧气与血红蛋白分开，穿过细胞膜和血管壁，进入周围组织；红细胞仍在血管里。: Some oxygen separates from hemoglobin, crosses the cell membrane and vessel wall, and enters nearby tissue. The red cell stays in the vessel.
真实红细胞不会每次把氧气全部卸光。图中六个标记只追踪一小部分氧气，并非含氧量测量: Real red cells do not unload all their oxygen on every trip. These six markers follow a small sample, not a measurement of oxygen content.
这次追踪一种能吞入细菌的白细胞。注意它如何改变形状，通过血管壁细胞之间，再包围目: Follow one type of white cell that can engulf bacteria. Watch its shape change as it passes between vessel-wall cells and surrounds a target.
中性粒细胞是白细胞的一种。受到周围化学信号引导后，它可以离开血流，到组织中工作。: A neutrophil is one type of white cell. Chemical signals can guide it out of the bloodstream to work in tissues.
白细胞能够变形，通过内皮细胞连接处。这里放慢并放大这个过程，周围红细胞并不跟着穿: The white cell changes shape and passes through an endothelial junction. This process is enlarged and slowed; nearby red cells do not follow it out.
细胞膜包围细菌，形成内部的小囊泡。细胞还需要后续的化学过程才能分解它，不是碰一下: The membrane wraps around the bacterium, forming an internal compartment. Further chemical processes are needed to break it down; contact alone does not make it vanish.
看小小的血小板先黏附、聚集，再由纤维蛋白网络加固。不是红细胞主动跑来修补血管。: Watch tiny platelets stick and gather, then see a fibrin network reinforce them. Red cells do not actively rush over to repair the vessel.
血管出现小破口: A small break in a vessel
血小板是大细胞分出的片段。它们遇到破损处暴露的结构和信号后，可以被激活并黏附。: Platelets are fragments shed by larger cells. Structures and signals exposed at damage can activate them and make them adhere.
激活的血小板改变形状并招来伙伴，形成暂时的血小板栓。这个画面没有展示所有凝血反应: Activated platelets change shape and recruit others to form an initial plug. This scene omits many clotting reactions.
血浆中的凝血蛋白参与形成纤维蛋白网，使局部血栓更稳固。后来还有组织修复和血栓清除: Clotting proteins in plasma help form a fibrin mesh that stabilizes the local clot. Tissue repair and clot removal follow later.
红色不等于红细胞做所有事: Red does not mean red cells do every job
血液里还有以水为主的血浆、不同白细胞，以及血小板。它们的数量和本领都不一样。: Blood also contains mostly-water plasma, different white cells and platelets. Their numbers and abilities differ.
白细胞不是同一种小球: White cells are a varied group
中性粒细胞能吞入一些细菌；B 细胞、T 细胞等还有不同任务。这里仅示范其中一种过: Neutrophils can engulf some bacteria; B cells, T cells and others have different jobs. Only one process is shown here.
血液一直是红色系: Blood stays within shades of red
含氧丰富与较少时，血液呈不同深浅的红。人体静脉里的血不是蓝色。图中紫色细胞核是说: Oxygen-rich and oxygen-poorer blood have different shades of red. Blood inside human veins is not blue. Purple nuclei here are illustrative colours.
红细胞留在血管内: Red cells stay inside the vessel

放大看：细丝长度不变，重叠增加: Close view: fixed-length filaments overlap more
